Questions we get asked

Lawn mowing & garden care FAQs

How much does lawn mowing cost in Toongabbie and Western Sydney?

Price depends on the size of the lawn, how often it is cut and whether edging and green waste removal are included (they are, in ours). Regular customers on a fortnightly round pay less per visit than one-off cuts. Send us a photo or your address and we will give you a fixed price.

Do you offer ride-on mowing for acreage properties in Dural and The Hills?

Yes. We run ride-on mowers for larger blocks, acreage and paddocks across Dural, Kenthurst, Glenorie and The Hills, and finish the edges and tight corners with a push mower so the whole property looks consistent.

Can you handle regular garden maintenance for strata blocks in Parramatta?

We do. We look after common-area gardens, lawns and nature strips for strata and townhouse complexes in Parramatta, Westmead and Blacktown on a fixed schedule with one monthly invoice.

How often should I have my lawn mowed in Sydney?

Fortnightly in spring and summer, when buffalo, couch and kikuyu lawns grow fastest, and every three to four weeks through autumn and winter. We will recommend a schedule when we quote and adjust it through the year.

Do you do hedge trimming and pressure washing in the Inner West?

Yes. We service Strathfield, Burwood, Ashfield, Marrickville and the surrounding Inner West suburbs for hedge trimming, garden tidy-ups and pressure washing, often on the same visit.

Which areas of Sydney does Greater Sydney Landscapes service?

We are based in Toongabbie and service Toongabbie, Parramatta, Blacktown, The Hills, Hornsby, Dural and the Inner West, with larger landscaping projects across wider Sydney by arrangement.
